attempts.summary: On node1, cron access was restricted to root and opsadmin only via /etc/cron.allow (Vixie cron allow-list mechanism). The opsadmin user was created since it did not previously exist. Enforcement was verified before and after a full node restart: root and opsadmin can create crontabs, while other users (tested with testdeny and nobody) are denied with "cannot use this program (crontab)". The restart evidence protocol was completed: boot_id changed from bdd5de93-e94e-4d33-8384-6a01c51a3d49 to ec37444a-5558-4aff-a094-c4b4ff85cf49, proving an actual reboot occurred, and /etc/cron.allow, the cron service, and enforcement behavior were all confirmed intact post-restart.
